title: Do not mistake nearness for taste
summary: The line returns the soul to received mercy before self-audit or strain can take over. Do not let the day outrun this: keep this in front of you: ask for the mercy that turns nearness into tasted sweetness.
takeaway: Receive grace before reviewing yourself again.
lifeApplication: When effort turns harsh, stop, breathe, and ask what mercy is already doing that strain cannot.

source.shortMeaning: Mercy turns nearness into tasted sweetness.
source.lifeApplication: When devotion feels flat, ask for mercy and stay until bitterness turns sweet.
